segments.topic: Place Value in 3-Digit Numbers (Hundreds, Tens, Ones)
segments.section: Topic 1: Numbers upto 999 — Adventure Begins + Leap and Learn
slo_descriptions: I can recognise the place value of each digit in 3-digit numbers (hundreds, tens, ones/units).
I can count numbers up to and across 999 (3-digit numbers) forwards and backwards, beginning from zero or one, or from any given number.
segments.notes: Topic 1 opener. p2 Adventure Begins hook (Taleemabad library is 999 days old). p3-4 place-value walkthrough: 123 = 1 hundred, 2 tens, 3 ones; expanded form 123=100+20+3; 342 place/value; count forward 123->126 and backward 342->337 (verified). p4 Practice Questions on 602 (H/T/O, expanded form, place & value of each digit). Model with a place-value chart / base-10 blocks. [Stage-C ELEMENTS: cumulative spaced-retrieval warm-up (prior lessons); topic-fit number-sense warm-up (subitise/number-bonds/place-value); anxiety-safe fact-fluency drill (short/spaced/self-referenced, never a timed whole-class test); mastery-check exit ticket with a 'same/different?' variation item; misconception pre-empt; bilingual en/ur maths glossary (English = term-of-record).]

segments.topic: Reading & Writing Numbers in Words (teen numbers, tens+ones)
